title: Holiday Game Wishes: free, personalized AI-built games for kids in the hospital or families in need
author: HallucinatedGames
selftext: This holiday season, I am taking a number of game wish requests for families in need. Their idea, their characters, their name or nickname on the title screen. Free, customized, and private. I'm expanding my Hallucinated Games project so if you or someone you know could benefit from something like this, check out the family friendly games I built with my kids, and send this contact page to anyone you know who may be interested. Also in this group, maybe its something the community may want to do themselves. This channel has a lot of AI Game Builders - why not use that to brighten up someones day and others go and do something similar? Happy Holidays. [https://www.hallucinatedgames.com/game-wishes/](https://www.hallucinatedgames.com/game-wishes/) \- (Note: Not sure what flair to add here for this?)

comments.author: PrestigiousExcuse655
comments.body: I think a game that could simulate adjusting to life outside of the hospital? for getting ready/for kiddos who may not experience those types of things soon due to long term care... something cozy and happy
